clue.text: With no chance in the race

definitions.text: With no chance in the race

parts.words: With no chance in the race
parts.note: a racing phrase for a horse or candidate with no hope of winning, read here both literally and figuratively

explanation.surface: A runner or candidate who has no hope of winning.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes a contender with no prospect of victory, whether in an election or on the track.

clue.text: Don't eat off this every day

definitions.text: Don't eat off this every day

parts.words: Don't eat off this every day
parts.note: the clue suggests special-occasion crockery, but the item meant is a small piece of furniture used now and then

explanation.surface: Advice about saving the best dinnerware for special days.
explanation.definitionFit: A small side table used only now and then, the clue punning on 'not every day'.

clue.text: Linger covered in black stuff

definitions.meaning: to stay on or delay leaving
smeared with pitch, the sticky black road material

explanation.surface: Someone lingering while getting coated in something dark.
explanation.definitionFit: One spelling serves as a verb meaning to dawdle and as an adjective meaning coated with tar.

clue.text: Smack novice in kind act

indicators.note: the novice is placed inside the kind act

parts.note: a favour is a kind act
L is the learner, a novice, as on British L-plates

explanation.surface: A beginner is slapped while doing someone a good turn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Smack' looks like a blow, but it means a taste: 'a smack of garlic'.
explanation.definitionFit: A smack is a slight taste or tang, the same as a savour.

clue.text: Will she be the recipient?

parts.note: 'Will' reads as a future verb but is the legal document leaving property to a woman

explanation.surface: Asking whether a particular woman will receive something.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman set to inherit an estate is the one a will benefits.

clue.text: We learn about rebirth

indicators.note: about signals the letters of these words being moved around into a new order

explanation.surface: A group discovering something about being born again.
explanation.definitionFit: A renewal is a revival or fresh start, a figurative rebirth.

clue.text: No French clue rewritten in-eluded an elementary particle

indicators.note: something rewritten has its letters put down again in a new order

parts.note: non is French for no

explanation.surface: A French denial and a puzzle hint, rewritten, describing physics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in-eluded' appears to be an OCR garble of the printed link, probably 'included' or 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Protons and neutrons, the constituents of an atomic nucleus, are collectively nucleons, subatomic particles.

clue.text: One about to contain tribal warfare is easily annoyed

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: the short word for about holds the reworked tribal letters within it

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: warfare suggests violent disorder, so the letters of tribal are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone who has to control fighting between tribes and is short-tempered.
explanation.definitionFit: Irritable describes a person who is quick to take offence or lose patience.

clue.text: Do very well in the pool

definitions.text: Do very well in the pool

parts.words: Do very well in the pool
parts.note: a swimmer's success in the water, also an idiom for any affair going smoothly

explanation.surface: A swimmer doing brilliantly in the water.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to make excellent progress, the clue taking it literally about swimming.

clue.text: People not going by public transport are in the pink

parts.note: people who drive rather than take buses go by car
a nation is a people

explanation.surface: Motorists are flourishing and in good health.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the pink' suggests good health, but pink is the flower family that includes this bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: This flower belongs to the genus Dianthus, whose members are commonly called pinks.

clue.text: Another trace will show you something is missing

definitions.text: will show you something is missing

indicators.note: another form of the word trace means its letters set in a different order

explanation.surface: A further mark revealing that something has gone.
explanation.definitionFit: The proofreader's mark ^ is inserted in text to show where words have been omitted.

clue.text: Looking through this, secret agent sees a miserable place

parts.note: a spy is a secret agent
a hole is slang for a dismal, wretched place

explanation.surface: An undercover operative peers through and finds a squalid dump.
explanation.definitionFit: A peephole in a door is the small opening one looks through.

clue.text: Eat in at what time for wholemeal

indicators.note: the clue says to put the eating inside the time question

parts.note: when means at what time
taken as written

explanation.surface: Asking when to dine in on wholemeal bread.
explanation.definitionFit: Wheaten describes bread made from whole wheat, so wholemeal.

clue.text: Home for a tailless animal

indicators.note: with no tail means the animal's final letter is cut off

parts.note: a seal is a marine animal

explanation.surface: Looking for a house for an animal missing its tail.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures a pet without a tail; the sea is in fact the seal's home.
explanation.definitionFit: The ocean is the habitat where marine creatures live.

clue.text: Don's perplexed about hostilities advancing

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go around the fighting
perplexed suggests confusion, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: the letters of Don's, apostrophe ignored
war is armed hostilities

explanation.surface: An academic is baffled by fighting as it moves forward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts the anagram ONDS (from DONS, signalled by 'perplexed') around WAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Onwards means moving forward, the same as advancing.

clue.text: Self-control exercised by an executor?

parts.note: an executor administers a will, so the authority he exercises is the power of a will

explanation.surface: Wondering about the restraint shown by someone managing an estate.
explanation.definitionFit: Determination or strength of mind is the quality of restraining one's impulses.

clue.text: Subscription owing

explanation.surface: A membership fee that has not yet been paid.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a noun for a membership fee and an adjective for money payable.

clue.text: Lengthy salute for an Archer?

parts.note: long means lengthy
a bow is a salute or greeting

explanation.surface: A drawn-out greeting made to someone named Archer.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital A suggests a surname; the archer is a bowman, whose weapon this is.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall English bow drawn by hand was the weapon of the medieval bowman.

clue.text: Outside broadcast, one on witchcraft

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A television crew filming on location about sorcery.
explanation.definitionFit: Obi, or obeah, is a form of sorcery practised in the Caribbean.

clue.text: Admitted everybody was in debt

parts.note: all means everybody
owed describes a sum still due

explanation.surface: Confessing that everyone had money owing.
explanation.definitionFit: Admitted in the sense of let in or permitted means allowed.

clue.text: We wander from the island

parts.note: taken as written
to stray is to wander

explanation.surface: People roaming away from an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Westray is one of the Orkney islands off northern Scotland.

clue.text: Plunder new-fangled idol inwardly telepathic?

indicators.note: the mind-reading letters sit inside the reworked word
new-fangled means made in a new way, so the letters are put in a new order

parts.note: ESP, extrasensory perception, is telepathic power

explanation.surface: Robbing a modern idol who seems to read minds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inwardly' puts ESP inside DOIL, the anagram of IDOL signalled by 'new-fangled'.
explanation.definitionFit: To despoil is to strip of possessions by force, to pillage.

clue.text: Time to have a holiday two years after American presidential election

definitions.meaning: a half-term break in the school or university year

definitions.text: two years after American presidential election
definitions.meaning: US congressional elections held halfway through a president's term

explanation.surface: A break that coincides with American elections.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a half-term break and also the US elections held halfway through a presidency.

clue.text: Company get-togethers

parts.note: suggests office parties, but means businesses joining together

explanation.surface: Social gatherings for a firm's staff.
explanation.definitionFit: When firms combine into one, the deals are amalgamations.

clue.text: Despise theologian going round island with Ian in a frenzy

indicators.note: the theologian's letters go round the island

parts.note: DD is Doctor of Divinity, a theologian

indicators.note: a frenzy throws things wildly about, so these letters are mixed

explanation.surface: Scorning a churchman touring an island in a mad rush with a friend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a frenzy' turns IAN into AIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Disdain as a verb means to look down on with scorn.

clue.text: Animal going east and west alternately

parts.note: E is the compass abbreviation for east
W is the compass abbreviation for west

explanation.surface: A creature heading first one way and then the other.
explanation.walkthrough: 'alternately' means east, west, east again, so E appears twice.
explanation.definitionFit: A female sheep is a farm animal.

clue.text: Key workers

parts.note: suggests essential staff, but means people who press keyboard keys

explanation.surface: Essential staff in public services.
explanation.definitionFit: Office staff who work at keyboards spend the day striking keys.

clue.text: Composer or explorer in Italian capital

parts.note: James Clark Ross was a British polar explorer

indicators.note: the capital letter of Italian is its first

explanation.surface: A musician or adventurer in Rome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Italian capital' suggests Rome, but means just the first letter of 'Italian'.
explanation.definitionFit: Gioachino Rossini was the Italian composer of The Barber of Seville.

clue.text: Story held up by the dailies

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the letters are read from bottom to top
the story is held within the letters of the word dailies

explanation.surface: A tale delayed by the newspapers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'held' and 'up' together make 'held up', a delay; split, they give a hidden word read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Homer's epic poem about the Trojan War is a great story.

clue.text: One genuflecting in a leafy shelter

definitions.meaning: a person who bends the knee or bows
a shady arbour in a garden

explanation.surface: Someone kneeling in a garden arbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Pronounced two ways, the word is one who bows and also a shady garden retreat.

clue.text: Working in the theatre?

parts.note: suggests an actor's job, but the theatre is a surgical one

explanation.surface: Someone employed on the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Surgeons performing surgery are at work in the operating theatre.

clue.text: Not the time to do afternoon shopping

definitions.text: Not the time to do afternoon shopping

parts.words: Not the time to do afternoon shopping
parts.note: refers to the weekday when British shops traditionally shut at lunchtime

explanation.surface: Advice about when to avoid going to the shops after lunch.
explanation.walkthrough: British towns once had a fixed weekday on which shops closed at midday.
explanation.definitionFit: The traditional weekday half-holiday when shops in a British town shut at lunchtime.
